Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please study the following key literature on static TEI web publication, semantic modeling, and digital commentary:

  • TEI Consortium. "Chapter 17: Simple Analytic Mechanisms." TEI P5 Guidelines, Version 4.8.0, 2024. Focus on § 17.1 (Notes and Annotations).
  • Vander Meulen, David L. "The Digital Commentary: Past Practices and Future Directions." Textual Cultures, 12(2), 2019, pp. 45–72.
  • Grallert, Till. "Editing Mundane Texts across the Digital Divide" (Ch. 5: TEI P5, GitHub Pages, and minimal-computing static publishing). In The Companion to Digital Humanities in Practice, ed. C. Crompton, L. Estill, R. J. Lane, and R. Siemens, Routledge, 2025, pp. 70–83 (Open Access).
  • Stoyanova, Slavina, Øyvind Eide, and Enes Türkoglu. "Modeling Cultural Heritage Materials for Discovery and Analysis" (Ch. 10). In The Companion to Digital Humanities in Practice, Routledge, 2025, pp. 159–178 (Open Access).
  • Dase, Kyle. "Towards a Model of the Network Edition" (Ch. 7). In The Past, Present, and Future of Early Modern Digital Studies: Iter at 25 (NTMRS 11), Iter Press, 2023, pp. 145–169 (Open Access).
